controlledModelTrial.class: Operator-authored read-only baseline with host-supplied LAN model candidates, pinned Harness2 and isolated collision physics

boundaries: The host owns model routes, task selection and adoption. No provider credentials enter the core or worker.
The fixture checks flat collision movement, not water, combat, live scene cloning or gameplay improvement.
The failed candidate was retained as evidence and not adopted. This controlled trial is not autonomous live learning.
Source, packages, production loading and actual gameplay effects are recorded separately.
